name: Lactose-Free Greek Yogurt Herbed Ranch Dip
whyItWorks: Uses strained Greek yogurt or lactose-free sour cream with savory powders to avoid high-lactose buttermilk and MSG/preservatives.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk plain strained Greek yogurt with a splash of lactose-free milk, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and finely rubbed dried dill.
